Phase5_Engineering.description: Transient time-domain deformation, velocity, and statistical strain features.

Phase6_Spectral_FFT.description: Frequency-domain power distribution, dominant frequency, and spectral centroid.

Phase6_Wavelet.description: Discrete wavelet decomposition energies, transient detail-to-approximation ratio, and wavelet entropy.

Phase8_Physics_Guided_Indices.description: Bounded, deterministic, dimensionless physics-guided engineering indices (DSTI, PEI, SII, DRI).

Excluded_Features_Documentation.peak_time: Recording timestamp dependent on operator trigger time, not an intrinsic material/sensor property.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.peak_shift_signed: Signed version of peak shift; physical magnitude captured unambiguously by peak_shift_abs.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.max_slope_pos_neg: Directional components; overall dynamic transient rate captured by max_slope_abs.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.variance: Exact mathematical square of std_dev; excluded to eliminate perfect redundancy.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.residual_shift_abs: Contains 3/12 missing values (25%) due to unrecovered baseline within window; captured systematically via Phase 8 PEI and SII.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.recovery_time_seconds: Contains 3/12 missing values (25%) due to unrecovered baseline within window; captured systematically via Phase 8 PEI and DRI.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.peak_width_seconds: Contains 8/12 missing values (67% missingness); excluded to preserve dataset integrity without synthetic imputation.
Excluded_Features_Documentation.metadata_columns: Material, Sensor, FBG, Expert, File, Impact_Status, Index_Status excluded completely to ensure unsupervised PCA.
